question: What specific daily observance constitutes the parṇa-kṛcchra vow defined in this prescription?
premises: The observance is identified as this parṇa-kṛcchra vow.
The vow involves substances consumed each day.
The consumption is performed separately on each occasion.
inference: The parṇa-kṛcchra vow consists of consuming leaves separately on each day.
uncertainties: The exact type or preparation of leaves implied by pītaiḥ is not specified in this verse.
